items.title: Marian McPartland — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Another guy who would come in, but he would come in in not terribly good shape, Wilbur Ware.

ctx.x: “Swinging ’Til the Girls Come Home.” We used to play all those tunes with him. Another guy who would come in, but he would come in in not terribly good shape, Wilbur Ware. What a fine bass player he was.
